text_blocks.snippet: Bank of China mortgage rates vary depending on the specific loan product, interest rate type (floating or fixed), and loan term. For example, in New Zealand, the standard floating rate is 8.89% p.a., while a 1-year fixed rate is 6.25% p.a. Special interest rates, often with discounts, are available for certain loans, such as a floating rate of 6.99%* and a 1-year fixed rate of 5.25%*. Rates can also vary based on whether it's a standard rate, special rate, or a "Plus Home Loan" rate.
